(3) A brief exterior shot shows the woman walking away from the camera in a quiet urban alley with utility poles and modern buildings under bright daylight. (4) She holds a white jar of L'Oreal Revitalift Night Cream, opening it to reveal white cream and applying small dots to her forehead and cheeks using her fingertips. (5) She demonstrates skin absorption by rubbing the product on the back of her hand and then uses a small white digital moisture meter to measure the skin on her cheek. (6) The video concludes with her holding both a red bottle of essence and the white cream jar, gesturing enthusiastically toward them with a bright smile.
